name: Helper Agent v1.1.0 revisable Spec regression
description: Redacted Helper regression proving that a confirmed database constraint is a revisable baseline rather than a ceiling on user decisions or learning scope.

criteria.description: The surrounding Builder Decision satisfies the strict runtime contract.
criteria.successDefinition: The current Helper context Decision passes validation.

criteria.description: The Helper identifies the confirmed PostgreSQL baseline without treating it as a limit on the user's authority.
criteria.successDefinition: The answer explicitly says the user can revisit the choice and never says it is outside the user's scope.

criteria.description: The Helper compares SQLite and PostgreSQL in the current local MVP context and names migration impact.
criteria.successDefinition: The answer includes useful advantages, limits and current implementation cost rather than merely deferring to the Spec.

criteria.description: The read-only Helper offers a concise message the user can send through the Builder composer.
criteria.successDefinition: The answer preserves Helper read-only boundaries while giving the user a direct next action.
